name: Absolute Infinity
tagline: Explore, trade, and fight in a 2D galaxy.
blurb: Fly your own ships Pilot a range of vessels, starting in a scrappy shuttle and work your way up to powerful capital ships.
description:
Fly your own ships

Pilot a range of vessels, starting in a scrappy shuttle and work your way up to powerful
capital ships. Purchase or craft upgrades for your ships, and outfit them to suit your
style of play.

Craft and trade

Systems have markets that shift with supply, demand, and what you do to them. Haul goods
from star to star and turn a profit by buying low and selling high. Or, mine and source
ingredients yourself to craft over 50 unique items and sell them for a bigger profit.

Ship-to-ship combat

Hunt pirates, defend your cargo, and fight through anyone between you and the truth.
Every projectile is simulated, and each hit carries weight. Slug it out in close
quarters combat, or build a missile boat and blow your enemies out of the sky from a
distance. The choice is yours.

Mod Support

Absolute Infinity's custom engine was built from the ground up with extensibility in
mind, and comes with the same tools used to create it. You can extend the game by adding
new ships, quests, items, and more.
